invariants: Book Lab action IDs are disjoint from the frozen core 90 action IDs.
Book Lab never reads contributor-only SceneNote text; only a confirmed Memory and an active per-memory-per-book grant enter the authorized projection.
Photo visibility, placement confirmation, Memory confirmation and book authorization are independent states.
Owner, reviewer and renderer cannot create or infer a contributor grant.
User answers are append-only submissions; confirmation binds one submission id/hash and no v0 model operation may rewrite answer text.
Every mutation has idempotency and declared version guards; multi-aggregate writes commit atomically.
Withdrawal blocks reads synchronously before purge and invalidates every affected preview and artifact.
Frozen manifests are immutable; post-freeze withdrawal adds a denial overlay and requires a new version excluding withdrawn content.
Canonical HTML and PDF derive from the same frozen manifest and carry equal book/version/manifest/page/source identity.
Book Lab failure cannot change or block upload, placement, album reads or scene viewing.
A withdrawn book_contribution_grants row is terminal and cannot be reactivated in place; a later affirmative authorization creates a distinct grantId.
BookPage.sourcePhotoId is immutable provenance for the Memory while displayPhotoId is the owner-selected visual; replacing the display photo never changes grant identity or source provenance.
Authorize, grant withdrawal, Memory withdrawal and source revoke make any queued/ready/failed draft preview stale; current projections filter immediately and stale worker output is never published.
Source revoke also makes affected frozen versions unreadable and revokes every unpurged artifact; every read reloads current Core photo version/content/deletion eligibility before artifact lookup.

Every owner read and mutation uses the current canonical Core Account owner branch; each owner mutation lock-reads and revalidates that branch inside its business transaction without adding a Book Lab CAS field.
The renderer consumes only immutable frozen manifest, AuthorizedMemoryText snapshots and frozen local assets; it never queries live PersonalMemory or rewrites user text.
